subject: english
question:
Fill in the blank with the correctly spelt word.

The author's prose was filled with ________ imagery.
solution:
The correct answer is **option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling of the word is **'chiaroscuro'**.
 
• The term **chiaroscuro** refers to the treatment of light and shade in drawing and painting. It is used to create a dramatic effect by emphasizing contrasts between light and dark areas.
 
• This word comes from the Italian words "*chiaro*" (light) and "*scuro*" (dark).

**Correct sentence:** The author's prose was filled with *chiaroscuro* imagery.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The other options are misspelled versions of the word:
 
 
• **Option 1: chiaroscuoro** - Incorrect due to extra "o".
 
• **Option 2: chairoscuro** - Incorrect due to misplaced "i".
 
• **Option 3: chairoscouro** - Incorrect due to extra "u".
 
 
• Always ensure correct spelling, especially for borrowed words, by referring to reliable dictionaries or language resources.
